name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.9 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2026-05-28, at wavelengths from 1.67 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
